stories.summary: Researchers have released AI4AI‑Bench, a new suite of tasks that evaluates large language model agents on algorithmic design problems aimed at recursive self‑improvement. The benchmark provides standardized metrics to compare how effectively LLMs can generate, analyze, and iteratively refine code that enhances their own capabilities.

stories.summary: Researchers demonstrate a new approach using vision-language models to enhance robotic task and motion planning by incorporating evidence-based decision-making. The method aims to improve reliability and adaptability in complex environments.

The method leverages pre‑trained deep architectures to adapt to new regression tasks with limited labeled data, offering a promising direction for statistical learning and AI applications.

stories.summary: Waymo has significantly increased its lobbying expenditures as it competes with Uber in the robotaxi market. The move reflects intensifying regulatory and policy battles in the autonomous vehicle industry.

stories.summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) has announced a collaboration with OpenAI to integrate artificial intelligence into its core operations. The move aims to transform the bank into an AI-native institution, enhancing efficiency and customer services.

stories.summary: Researchers introduced MemTrapBench, a suite of tests designed to identify and quantify cognitive traps that arise from how LLMs store and retrieve information. The benchmark highlights systematic memory pitfalls, offering a diagnostic tool to improve model robustness and guide future architecture design.

stories.summary: Researchers have introduced a three‑phase post‑training pipeline—Inject, Align, Recover—that enables large language models to absorb and use document‑level information without relying on external retrieval mechanisms. Experiments show the approach matches or outperforms retrieval‑augmented systems while reducing latency and infrastructure complexity.
